note: The `minecraft:sixteen_way_rotation` value for `enabled_states` was released out of beta in format version 1.26.30. Use it (together with the corresponding block state) to rotate blocks in 22.5° increments around the Y axis based on the player's yaw at placement time.
note2: The `minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction` value for `enabled_states` is available without the Beta APIs toggle starting in 1.26.0. When enabled, set `blocks_to_corner_with` to the block descriptors that should trigger the corner shape (commonly paired with the `minecraft:placement_position` trait's `minecraft:vertical_half` state).
note3: In format version 1.26.20, validation tightened: the rotation offset must be an exact multiple of 90.0 in the range 0.0–360.0 (the previous 0.5 tolerance was removed), and `blocks_to_corner_with` now requires `minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction` to be present in `enabled_states`.
note4: Fixed in 1.26.10: blocks using `minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction` now correctly form inner corners when adjacent to other stairs.

generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Adds the "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction", "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" and/or "minecraft:sixteen_way_rotation" states and setter function to the block.

fields.description: A list of block descriptors that define the blocks to connect with the corner shape.

fields.title: Enabled States
fields.description: Which states to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction", "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction", "minecraft:sixteen_way_rotation"].

fields.title: y Rotation Offset
fields.description: The y rotation offset to apply to the block. Must be [0.0, 90.0, 180.0, 270.0, 360.0]. Default is 0, meaning if the player is facing north, the "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction", and/or "minecraft:sixteen_way_rotation" state will be north.
